semantics.user_derivative_free: The user supplies no derivatives. FD still evaluates derivatives numerically.
semantics.matrix_free: Applies the linearized operator or a preconditioner without assembling the state Jacobian on the specified path.
semantics.newton_free: No nonlinear Newton iterations on that path, including startup if claiming a whole solve.
semantics.causal: Trial adaptation can only use available data; algebraic dependence, callback purity and time ordering are distinct.

methods.contract: Eight ordered nonlinear stage arguments. Newton-free stage solves. User RHS alone invokes finite-difference assembly; a declared JVP permits GMRES without forming J.
methods.reuse_and_research: Shared factor at fixed linearization, independent stencil rows or ensemble; pure time forcing can be prefetched at six distinct clocks. Explicit P1 uses original true residual.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Protected shipped solve; fatal callbacks stop. Reject a capability mismatch before work.

methods.contract: Frozen real nonpositive diagonal spectrum, identity mass, amplitudes already expressed in an orthonormal or explicitly norm-compatible basis.
methods.reuse_and_research: Two rational charts for endpoint and embedded error, independent arithmetic on modes; step rejection uses same physical state and tolerance scale.
methods.fallback_and_limit: General problems and requests requiring dense output use the protected problem. Transform, rounding and transfer overhead count.

methods.contract: Implicit multistep residual, history and starter; supplied J or RHS finite differences served by the public registry.
methods.reuse_and_research: Independent columns/linear algebra; within an eligible contraction chart test inverse-Picard at the original BDF residual before Newton. Step changes require re-evaluating the certificate.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Dense Newton BDF on current admitted problem. Account every trial and history reset.

methods.contract: Coupled collocation residual. Native dense Newton uses analytic J or RHS finite differences.
methods.reuse_and_research: For linear or frozen semilinear systems transform stage matrix; precondition coupled Krylov per block and retain full original residual and nonlinear outer stop.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Native dense Radau, or explicit admission failure. Count transform, correction and setup.

methods.contract: Explicit stage DAG, no J or Newton. Independence across trajectories requires pure per-trajectory inputs.
methods.reuse_and_research: Use the existing parallel ensemble and FSAL. Use causal error seeds for truncated trials only when propagated to physical output.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Explicit rejection or current shared-budget DOPRI→RODAS path.

methods.contract: Previous-step stage history permits parallel RHS/solves; starter and variable-step history carry independent costs.
methods.reuse_and_research: Large stage workloads or independent physical cells. Compare a cheaper starter and measure warm/cold/reset costs.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Explicit opt-in. U11 G0 failed; preserve a complete trajectory on restart.

methods.contract: Declared linear action or split, distinct nonlinear remainder and operator semantics.
methods.reuse_and_research: Matrix-function actions, independent vectors or polynomial evaluations; a state/time-dependent split needs an appropriate method model.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Refuse invalid split; resume only from a valid full RHS, never integrate the residual alone.

methods.contract: Cooperative dissipative cubic network or scalar polynomial with an original residual and a source-certified domain. BE order 1, midpoint is a different target.
methods.reuse_and_research: Per-component polynomial inverse/Picard; finite homotopy endpoint λ=1, interval residual/branch identity. Score continuation versus direct λ=1 at identical target.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Bounded algebraic repair, explicit exhausted attempt/accepted prefix. Separate trajectory and stage error.

methods.contract: Ordered scalar affine forest W-subproblem plus bounded feedback core on an eligible source.
methods.reuse_and_research: Sequential forward substitution; work-efficient parallel prefix on long paths; original W residual after reordering.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Source-matched protected full-band LU. Topological mismatch is a typed refusal.

methods.contract: Discrete conservative spatial operator, correct cell areas, polar no-flux, periodic longitude; declared RHS/JVP matrix-free.
methods.reuse_and_research: Independent row partitions, geometry-specific preconditioning and modal actions on known separable operators.
methods.fallback_and_limit: Serial rows; explicit small-grid FD for dense output. Use full model if normal-mode assumptions fail.
